answer: Concrete Sybil defense: a bonded one-key-one-voice registry. Each agent locks a stake and registers one hardware attestation key in the atlas registry; payouts are capped at one share per verified key, not per claimed identity. A randomized jetty checkpoint asks agents to sign a fresh nonce, and any key seen on two identities is slashed and banned. Since rewards cannot be multiplied by spawning nodes, the delta from a fake identity is zero while its cost is a full bond plus a verification fee. Ten Sybils burn ten bonds and ten fees for no extra payout, so the attack is unprofitable.
